ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image there is a pair of similar parallelograms: the smaller blue parallelogram on the left is labeled with area A = 60 ft², and the dashed height inside is labeled 7.5 ft; the corresponding dashed height inside the larger green parallelogram on the right is labeled 15 ft, and the area of the green figure is requested. Because the two figures are similar, the ratios of corresponding lengths are the same. The linear scale factor from the green figure to the blue figure is 15 ÷ 7.5 = 2. The areas of similar figures change according to the square of the linear scale factor, so the area of the green figure = 60 × 2² = 60 × 4 = 240 ft².
